name: Revenant of Tsushima
summary:
Revenant of Tsushima is a first-person Japanese folklore horror adventure game developed by Aurora Studio, an independent game studio based in Hong Kong.

Set in a supernatural interpretation of Edo-period Japan, the game follows Tsushima Mewa on a mysterious journey through historical villages, mountain paths, shrines, and haunted landscapes inspired by the Tokaido route.

Players explore atmospheric environments, investigate supernatural incidents, interact with characters, collect spiritual clues, and encounter mysterious entities inspired by traditional Japanese folklore.

The experience combines environmental exploration, narrative-driven investigation, supernatural encounters, and elements of Japanese religious and cultural traditions.
